channel.title: What IS Pataphysics?
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "What IS Pataphysics?"

item.title: Re: What IS Pataphysics?
item.content:encoded:
If a SCP article breaks the fourth wall to speak to our real life, and an entity above our real life is interacted with indirectly or not (thus breaking the fifth wall), it's pataphysics. Perhaps an example would help.

Read SCP-1459 for context first.

Then here is some from the SCP-1459 extended testing logs:
http://www.scpwiki.com/scp-1459-extended-testing-log

Player: Dr. Westrin
Statement: "Metaphysics"
Result: An instance of SCP-1459-1 was released. After approximately 20 minutes, the instance received injuries consistent with being bludgeoned with a hammer. No cookie was dispensed.

Player: Dr. Westrin
Statement: "Pataphysics"
Result: A robotic arm extended from SCP-1459 and, through unknown narrative methods, proceeded to bludgeon the SCP-1459-1 instance in the "Metaphysics" entry. It is currently unknown how this was accomplished.
Note: The word "META" was written in frosting on the cookie.

item.title: Re: What IS Pataphysics?
item.content:encoded: I'd argue it's 4th wall breaking but more annoying because it thinks it's something else.

item.title: Re: What IS Pataphysics?
item.content:encoded: Kind of! Full-on fourth-wall breaks still happen, but mostly, it's the Foundation dealing with the fact that God is a bunch of horror writers. Or, if you believe Trevor Bailey's interpretation, a bunch of hacks.

item.title: Re: What IS Pataphysics?
item.content:encoded: Oh, so it's basically just evolved fourth wall breaking but less annoying?

item.title: Re: What IS Pataphysics?
item.content:encoded:
In the Foundation universe, pataphysics basically boils down to the Foundation realizing that they're fictional and trying to do something about it, whether that be controlling the narrative forces for their own gain, trying to rage against the authors (i.e. us) or using their knowledge to combat entities from in-universe fictional narratives that have been made real.

Pataphysics is beyond metaphysics— if the Christian God in the Foundation universe is metaphysical, then we, the authors who write that interpretation of god, are pataphysical.

item.title: What IS Pataphysics?
item.content:encoded:
I'm still not entirely clear on this, even after reading comments section and even the Wikipedia article. In real life it just seems like some artsy nonsense. But I still dunno what it is in the context of the Foundation universe. Something to do with narratives? Most of the articles I've read that reference it could easily substitute metaphysics without changing the meaning or story. Since metaphysics itself is undefined enough to get creative with. I think..?

So uh, little help?
